title: Modifies provisions relating to property tax payments

abstracts.abstract:
SB 1211 - Current law authorizes counties to provide for the payment of real and personal property taxes in installments, but excludes township counties from utilizing such payment plans. This act repeals such prohibition for township counties.

	This provision is identical to HB 388 (2025) and to a provision in SB 1517 (2026), and is substantially similar to a provision in SS/SCS/SBs 1410 & 853 (2026) and SS/SCS/HCS/HBs 1768 & 2060 (2026).
JOSH NORBERG
